ops.body: Active priority: eliminate repeated drive order set GitHub proof existence reads. Source: brief.unopened passes max_age=24h to CCX response cache, but vcsghcache invalidates on repo writes and retains shards only 1h. Implement a positive-only page-existence cache with its own 24h lifetime; failed reads remain uncached. Acceptance: cross-process repeated link check makes zero GitHub calls after success, unrelated repo writes do not expire it, expiry rechecks, release and local install verified. All other work remains held.
